description: Address code review findings: fix dead variables and hardcoded sub-scores in generateFallback(), and add input sanitization for chart upload API fields to prevent prompt injection.
steps: In api/analyze.js generateFallback(), the variables invLevel, bestCase, worstCase are computed but the sub-scores in the Confidence Breakdown section are hardcoded (5/25, 5/25, 12/25, 0/25) and do not sum to the displayed overall score. Fix by computing sub-scores that sum to the overall score and interpolating invLevel, bestCase, worstCase into the Scenario-Based Output section.

In api/analyze.js handleChartUpload(), add input sanitization for timeframe, ticker, and currentPrice fields from req.body. Strip newlines, limit length, and validate format before concatenating into the prompt string.
acceptance_criteria: generateFallback sub-scores (Technical + Entry Precision + Risk Management + News) sum to the overall score
invLevel, bestCase, worstCase variables are used in the template HTML (no dead code)
timeframe, ticker, and currentPrice are sanitized before prompt concatenation
